beats.care: Modi said India's metro network grew from 250 kilometres in 2014 to 1,100 now. Your city might be next in line.
beats.what: PM Modi and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay opened a 15 kilometre Chennai Metro stretch from Poonamallee to Vadapalani and rode it together.
beats.why: It is the first working corridor of Chennai Metro's second phase, built for about 4,900 crore rupees, with 11 elevated stations.

cards.body: Regular trains run from 7 am to 9 pm starting today. Modi also launched projects worth over ₹13,000 crore in Tamil Nadu, including a brain-mapping mission at IIT Madras.
A 3.7 km part of the line is a double-decker structure, and the signalling is ready for trains with no driver.

cards.note: Figures as stated by PM Modi; now across 25 cities.
